query: My 76-year-old disabled father is a serious hoarder. I previously had to seek guardianship when he was stuck in a chair with bed sores and nearly septic, then reversed it after he improved and daily helpers were arranged. Now he is buying furniture he does not need or have room for and keeps asking me to pick it up. I do not want to add to the hoard, but I know he will be angry if I refuse. What am I responsible for here?
